$comment: Pins the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars that Colloquium bundles. Both platforms are
built from source by .github/workflows/build-ffmpeg.yml so that the binaries
stay LGPL-2.1 (no libx264/libx265) and small (~13 MB each rather than the
113 MB of a prebuilt static build that links every codec library going).
To publish a new set: run the build-ffmpeg workflow, then paste the sha256 of
each uploaded archive below. A null sha256 means 'not published yet' — in that
case scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs builds the host's own binaries from source, so a
macOS or Windows dev is never blocked waiting on a release.
